item.title: Re: Te Horoi Pai (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
I'm pretty lost as to why this anomaly leads to a disappearance… you describe it as a compulsive effect to spread the love for this product (summing up/paraphrasing) and then people vanish? Are the entities doing something to them?

Also, I have to say the whole "make a thing that forces you to spread it around so that hours later you're attacked by otherworldly entities" isn't the most straight forward of concepts.

Thematically, these entities seem discordant with a product that enhances a person's hygiene. What does that have to do with something representing "subconscious fetishes or extremest fears"? I'd also suggest being careful with the demonizing of "fetishes" because such things are subjective and often seen as "gross" from the outside but is in reality just another form of sexual orientation repression… Like a sexual practice you find uncomfortable doesn't equate that practice with extreme fear… suggesting those are interrelated is dicey at best.

item.title: Te Horoi Pai
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror, Mystery

+ show block
– hide block

Elevator Pitch: A tube of Petroleum jelly. When ointment is applied to a human, a person's hygiene is enhanced. Prominent symptom manifest in the form of pheromone secretion and irrational compulsion to spread the ointment. Hours after patient zero is infected, the infected encounter amorphous entities. Appearing entities embody subconscious fetishes or extremest fears. They ignore beings lacking pheromone and are hostile to those marked with pheromone.

Central Narrative: On the 9th December, the mysterious disappearance of 25 guests and staff at the Westhaven Luxury Lodge made national headlines. A team of four Field Agents stationed at Nelson, New Zealand take over the investigation and create a cover story.

Field Agents are briefed about the crime scene by the police. Exploring the lodge they find five rooms in the hallway cordoned off by police tape. Foundation agents are alarmed by the crude messages scratched into the Manuka wood and signs glued onto the walls left behind by the lodging's former occupants. Text advertise and revere "a conditioner sent by the gods". Most jarringly, the other remainder of the text read "The knavish resistance were enlightened, now they too relish the heaven-sent scent". Conditioner called "Te Horoi Pai" , translated to Xtreme Conditioner is discovered and placed in containment. All other copies found in the Lodging or within Police custody are confiscated and destroyed.

Testing is conducted, discovering the anomaly's psycho-contagious nature. It's speculated an unknown G.O.I is at hand. A nationwide sweep, extensively covering every hotel, motel and supermarket in New Zealand, yields negative results. A Mobile Taskforce (Called Bad Hair Day) is conceived to monitor the domestic supply chain for wild instances.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Mass disappearance is unheard-of in the 21st century, creating mystery. The anomaly takes place in New Zealand. Testing reveals the ultimate fate of the Lodging's residents. Furthermore, the G.O.I theory is a hypothesis, since Te Horoi Pai is the product name but there is no brand associated nor a manufacturer stated on the bottle. Therefore, the Foundation attempts to contain a contagious SCP with no identified point of origin; an analogy for viral outbreak clusters with no immediate causes.

Additional Notes: This is a submission for my first "canon" SCP, so any form of criticism is appreciated (Bluntness is 100% tolerated but please be constructive).
